domain.ensure_application_schema.1.sql:
IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Company_TrainingSubject WHERE domain=N'academic' AND subject_name=N'通用知識') INSERT dbo.Company_TrainingSubject(subject_id,domain,subject_name,mock_question_count,mock_duration_minutes,mock_pass_score,is_active) VALUES(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(50),NEXT VALUE FOR dbo.TrainingSubjectsNumbers),N'academic',N'通用知識',40,45,70,1);
IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Company_TrainingSubject WHERE domain=N'practical' AND subject_name=N'術科申論') INSERT dbo.Company_TrainingSubject(subject_id,domain,subject_name,mock_question_count,mock_duration_minutes,mock_pass_score,is_active) VALUES(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(50),NEXT VALUE FOR dbo.TrainingSubjectsNumbers),N'practical',N'術科申論',0,0,0,1);

domain.ensure_application_schema.4.sql:
DECLARE @erp_no NVARCHAR(50)=CONVERT(NVARCHAR(50),NEXT VALUE FOR dbo.TrainingChaptersNumbers);
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Company_TrainingChapter WHERE subject_id=? AND chapter_code=N'UNSORTED')
                    INSERT dbo.Company_TrainingChapter (is_active,chapter_id,subject_id,chapter_code,chapter_name,display_order)
                    VALUES (1,@erp_no,?,N'UNSORTED',N'未分類',999)

domain.ensure_application_schema.10.sql:
INSERT dbo.Company_Department (is_active,department_name,updated_by)
                SELECT DISTINCT 1,s.department,N'schema-sync'
                FROM dbo.Company_Staff s
                WHERE s.department<>N''
                  AND NOT EXISTS (
                      SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Company_Department d WHERE d.department_name=s.department
                  )

domain.save_staff.3.sql:
MERGE dbo.Company_Staff AS target
                USING (SELECT ? AS employee_id) AS source ON target.employee_id=source.employee_id
                WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET display_name=?,gender=?,age=?,department=?,position=?,traits=?,biography=?,photo_file=?,is_active=1,updated_by=?,updated_at=SYSDATETIME()
                WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (is_active,employee_id,display_name,gender,age,department,position,traits,biography,photo_file,updated_by)
                VALUES (1,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?);

domain.add_operation.1.sql:

                (status,submission_id,operation_date,campus_code,category_code,quantity,note,submitted_by)
                OUTPUT inserted.submitted_at
